title: Why the flagship price differs from Lite/Core/Clinical
text: Two high-performance imaging paths instead of one compact capture module.
Large-field telecentric lens and 31 MP industrial metrology camera account for roughly ₹15.21 lakh before mounts, lighting and calibration [S8-S9].
Thor/T5000 compute, 10GigE networking, storage, cooling and development headroom exceed lower-tier needs [S6-S7].
Plate robotics, liquid handling, direct MIC, gas control, fluorescence and 3D profilometry add mechanics, service parts and validation burden.
The selling price must support engineering amortization, QA, calibration, installation, training, warranty, software, service spares, channel costs and regulatory work - not only the component BOM.
Clinical tiers may cost less by excluding research modules even though their method validation and quality-system costs remain substantial.
